about.storyHeading: A Harmonious Blend of Tradition, Warmth & Authentic Flavors
about.storyQuote: More than just a restaurant, Xutorok is a place where the distinctive flavours of Ukrainian cuisine blend with Armenian warmth and hospitality.
about.storyP1: Since 2019, Xutorok has been bringing together the rich culinary traditions of Armenian and Ukrainian cuisine. More than just a restaurant, Xutorok is a place where the distinctive flavours of Ukrainian cuisine blend with Armenian warmth and hospitality. The menu features well-known Ukrainian dishes, traditional beverages, and authentic recipes.
about.storyP2: The restaurant features a main dining hall accommodating up to 40 guests, along with 10 comfortable private rooms, designed for intimate gatherings, family occasions, festive celebrations, and enjoyable moments with loved ones.
about.cuisineP1: The menu features well-known Ukrainian dishes, traditional beverages, and authentic recipes, bringing together the rich culinary traditions of Armenian and Ukrainian cuisine.
about.cuisineP2: Every dish is prepared with care and dedication, blending the distinctive flavours of Ukrainian cuisine with Armenian warmth and hospitality.
about.cuisineFeature1Desc: Beloved national dishes perfected through heritage
about.cuisineFeature2Desc: Finest selected ingredients from trusted suppliers
about.cuisineFeature3Desc: Succulent meats prepared over authentic live fire

about.exteriorHeading: We Look Forward to Welcoming You
about.exteriorText: Warm hospitality, authentic flavors, and memorable dining await you at Xutorok for intimate gatherings, family occasions, and enjoyable moments with loved ones.
